decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (GSB/2/2017/OUT; received 13/04/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 3 Chaucer Avenue, TW4 6NA.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side and rear walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding to be used as a gym at the rear of the house
